name: diagnostics channel publish subscribe
source: import { channel } from 'node:diagnostics_channel'; function main(): void { const events = channel('thaw.test'); const listener = (message: Json): void => { console.log(message.value); }; events.subscribe(listener); events.publish({ value: 42 }); events.unsubscribe(listener); console.log(events.hasSubscribers); }
